summary: Backend-only regression for the batched N+1 fix in apply_daily_penalties() and send_evening_reminders(). 53/53 pytest pass (7 new + 46 prior). New file test_penalties_batched.py builds an isolated fresh family (2 kids), creates 5 tasks (A-only daily, all-kids daily, B-only daily done by B, weekly-A, once-A), triggers POST /api/dev/run-penalties, and asserts EXACT arithmetic: kid_a lost 28 pts (17 A-only + 11 all-kids), kid_b lost 11 pts (only all-kids — completed task excluded, A-only ignored, weekly/once ignored), both streaks reset to 0. Also asserted /api/penalties log rows contain expected (user_id, task_id, points_deducted=17, task_title) tuples for the newly-created penalties and do NOT contain rows for the completed/weekly/once/wrong-assignee combinations. Demo regressions revalidated: papa@demo.fr + lea@demo.fr login, PIN 1234, GET /api/tasks, POST /api/tasks/{id}/complete (non-photo → status='approved' + points +N), GET /api/challenges, GET /api/events (recurring), GET /api/badges (still 10 badges, Léa's unlocks intact). Full pre-existing suite (backend_test.py, test_badges.py, test_delete_account.py, test_tasks_regression.py) untouched and green.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:865-894 apply_daily_penalties: batching correctly done — one db.completions.find({family_id, day=today_key}) with projection {task_id,user_id,status} builds `done={(task_id,user_id): status}`; inner loop reads dict in O(1). Excludes pending|approved (matches prior find_one({status:{$in:['pending','approved']}}) filter). Behaviour identical.

server.py:897-918 send_evening_reminders: same batch pattern with a set of (task_id,user_id) — any completion (any status) counts as 'submitted' so no reminder is sent. Semantically identical to prior find_one existence check.
server.py:871 `frequency:'daily'` filter on tasks means weekly/once are never penalized — verified by test.
server.py:878 `if t['assigned_to'] and u['id'] not in t['assigned_to']: continue` correctly implements 'empty list = all kids'.
server.py:885 streak reset to 0 + last_streak_date=None on any penalty — verified by test (kid_b, penalized once, streak=0).
